items.item_text: 01. This application will ONLY be used to fill a temporary position. The temporary position will NOT turn into a permanent position. Do you understand this working condition? Options: Yes | No

02. Experience Requirement: One year of full-time experience is equivalent to 12 months of employment at 40 hours per week. Qualifying part-time experience will be prorated based on its full-time equivalent. Experience must be directly related to the position. Education Requirement: Thirty (30) semester units or forty-five (45) quarter units in a directly related field are equivalent to one (1) year of experience or one (1) year of school. All education and experience used to meet minimum qualifications must be clearly documented in the application. Do you understand this condition? Options: Yes | No

03. (MQ) Please select the level of education you possess: Please attach copies of your degrees or transcripts showing the date the degrees were awarded. Applications without this documentation may be deemed incomplete. Options: No formal or informal education equivalent to completion of the twelfth grade | Formal or informal education equivalent to completion of the twelfth grade or higher degree such as associate's degree
04. (MQ) Do you possess one year of work experience; or an equivalent combination of training and experience? Options: Yes | No
05. (MR) Do you possess work experience as a custodian? Options: Yes | No
06. Do you possess a valid Driver's License? Options: Yes | No
